items.title: Halloween Demons
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
Unleash your dark side this Halloween season! These 10 modern teens come with a dark side that is perfect for a Halloween, anime or school roleplay! 

- 10 demon skins
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: Robot Rangers
items.creator: Snail Studios
items.description:
Power up your ranged weapon game with specialized robots! Roleplay as ELITE robots they are the deadliest and scariest with neon red eyes lurking in the shadows.

~ 40 robot-themed skins in this MEGA skin pack!
~ 8 different robotic styles built with the latest hi-tech weapons!
~ 5 colors of robots to choose from to build a robot army!

Perfect for WEAPON EXPANSION MAPS!

items.title: Trendy Axolotls
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
Do you think the new axolotl mob is so cute? If so then these 12 trendy axolotl skins are perfect for you! Dress up in different outfits ranging from punk, school, sporty, onesies or whatever version of our favorite aquatic salamander you want to be! There is many different modern outfits to choose from! 

- 12 adorable skins
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming and Lothiredon

items.title: Race Crew
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description:
Ready, set, go! Are you READY for this awesome skin SET to GO race in? You better be because the Race Crew is waiting for you!

- 8 great skins!
- Great to ride in
- Made by: Artifact Studios

items.title: Millionaire Teens
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description:
Can you pay my bills? Yes you can! As a millionaire teen you can do whatever you want to do and more! Because you're a child with a great destiny...

- 8 rich skins
- Great for roleplay
- Made by: Artifact Studios

items.title: Halloween Party
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Trick or treat? The most awaited moment of the year has finally started! The streets are full of happy teens wearing spooky costumes and eating candy. So get into this spirit and take each opportunity as it's your last while having a great time scaring the mobs in town! Have fun!

+ 1 free skin
+ 15 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Mobs Highschool
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
High school has begun, and everyone is going back to school! Even the spookiest monsters need to learn new ways of scaring the citizens in town, so follow their example and be the best student of the year. The school backyard has missed the students' laughter in their breaks. New memories are waiting for you there!

+ 2 free skins
+ 16 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Halloween Demons
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
It’s going to be a great night to get away with some mischief! See how much trouble you can get into when you gear up in Halloween Demons skins. Role-play with friends in awesome costumes like skeletons, vampires and Frankenstein monsters, and your demon horns. Have a spooky good Halloween night!

+ 8 disguised spirit HD skins

items.title: Halloween Ghosts
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
It’s the haunting time! Become a supernatural spirit in Halloween Ghosts skins. Be like a floating lost soul, looking for someone to frighten. Role-play with friends as sad, happy, or scary images and send everyone running away. You are a phantom to be feared.

+ 8 ghostly shadow HD skins

items.title: SCP Zombies
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Become the scariest, most hostile mob around! Gear up and role-play with friends in SCP Zombies skins and try to survive. You’ll need all your unnatural mob powers to dodge special containment procedures. Everyone thinks you’re a threat, so you’ll have to make good use of your unusual qualities to stay free!

+ 8 secret skip undead HD skins

items.title: Robbers Camo
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Get ready to sneak around, hopefully undetected, in Robbers Camo skins. Role-play with friends in striped outfits perfect for thieves. Gear up in ski mask, hood or eye mask and awesome block textures. Make good use of the backpack to carry al your burglar tools.

+8 bandit disguise HD skins

items.title: TNT Mobs
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Get all charged up when you role-play with friends in TNT Mobs skins. Become a creeper, wolf, or cow in awesome red dynamite outfits that will make you look more than a little dangerous. Passive, neutral, or hostile, you’ll have a blast with these skins!

+ 8 explosive mobs HD skins

items.title: Halloween Costume Party
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
What are you going to be this year? Enjoy plenty of options with Halloween Costume Party skins. Get your scare on and dress up like a skeleton or Frankenstein monster. Role-play with friends as gentler teens when you gear up as a clown, superhero or angel. You’re sure to have a happy Halloween!

+ 8 spook-tacular HD skins

items.title: Techno Demons II
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Look like a dark creature from the future. Role-play with friends in true cyber style with Techno Demons skins. Gear up in sharp and modern horns and cool digital outfits. You can act like a troublemaker, but you’re really just trying to have fun! 

+ 8 electronic evil spirit HD skins

items.title: Goat Costumes
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
It’s fun to dress up as a farm animal! Show off your stubborn side in Goat Costumes skins. Role-play with friends in outfits and masks with horns, hooves, and beards. Try your best to wag your tail and bleat like a real goat. Become a kid, nanny, or billy and get ready to climb any mountain!

+ 8 awesome animal attire HD skins

items.title: Kitty Cats
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Purr and strut all around the city in cool cats skins. Role-play and raise your tail to say hello to your adorable fellow kitten friends. Look cute and stylish in the latest casual and dressy fashions. Groom your pretty fur and keep your whiskers in tip-top shape. Hunt, play, or sleep all day, it’s your choice. Meow!

+ 8 fine felines HD skins

items.title: Trendy Goats
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
No shaggy kids or nannies in this herd! Look your billy best when you gear up in Trendy Goats skins. Role-play with friends in stylish outfits, awesome beards, and cool horns. Become rich and famous as you dress up in luxury clothes and gold jewelry. Be ready to don a crown as real royalty or a cape as a superhero.

+ 8 groovy goat HD skins

items.title: Cartoon TNT
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Have some supercharged fun when you gear up in your favorite explosive blocks. Role-play with friends in funny Cartoon TNT skins. Look like the real thing with TNT textures, all in red. Enjoy a cartoony face with silly eyes and a foolish grin. You’ll look dynamite!

+ 8 comic blast HD skins

items.title: Neon Wardens
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Sneak up out of the Deep Dark biome with a glowing light on your chest. In electric blue or green or fluorescent pink or red, find your way around the city in Neon Wardens skins. Role-play with friends as tall, blind mobs that can sense when others are near. Even the invisible can’t get away from you, you’re just too strong and powerful! 

+8 bright and brawny HD skins

items.title: Anime Trend
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
How about taking a look at the most trending anime skins ever? Now choose your favorite skin and create your cute kawaii team with your friends!

+ 12 anime themed skins
+ 2 free skins
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Trick or Treat Teens
items.creator: Asiago Bagels
items.description:
Is it a trick? Or is a treat? Wear these Halloween skins all season! It's that time of the year again. Grab your friends, dress up, and have fun! 

+ 14 Skins!
+ 14 Halloween outfits!

items.title: Pastel School Teens
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
School is back in session! Now is the time to show off your cutest outfits to wow all your classmates. Become the star student while looking your best!

- 8 Pastel Skins!
- Perfectly Aesthetic!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Rainbow Trends
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
Always wanted a cool skin that has every color of the rainbow in it and gives the illusion to shine in the dark? Then this package will be your perfect match!

-12 skins
- perfect for roleplay 
-have fun!

items.title: Secret Creeper Base
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Super Secret Creeper Base! don't tell anyone! explore the base and find various activities and rooms!

Includes:

- Giant creeper base
- Gaming pc
- Swimming pool
- Underground farm
- Chest room
- Enchantment room
- Multiplayer and singleplayer
- Survival spawn
- And much more!

By: KA Studios
